findings.highlight: I was worried that Sakura might be pushing herself too hard.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は無茶をしていないようだ
findings.governingReading: 心配していたが、桜は無茶をしていないようだ contrasts previous worry with the reassuring current inference, explaining relief at Rider’s refusal to protect him.
findings.explanation: His present relief that Sakura is not pushing herself becomes only a past worry.

findings.evidenceJa: 本当に貴方は危なっかしい
findings.governingReading: 危なっかしい describes Shirou’s vulnerability and risk after offering rescue despite his condition.
findings.explanation: Being dangerously precarious becomes being unreliable.

findings.highlight: This thought just came out of nowhere
findings.evidenceJa: ほんっとーに今さらだけど
findings.governingReading: 今さらだけど marks very belated recognition or mention of her evident height.
findings.explanation: Belatedly noting an obvious height becomes a thought coming out of nowhere.

findings.highlight: I just wasn't sure why you froze up.
findings.evidenceJa: 理由が分からなくて固まってた
findings.governingReading: 理由が分からなくて固まってた is his answer that he was stalled by not understanding her concern.
findings.explanation: Shirou freezing because he did not understand the reason becomes him wondering why Rider froze.

findings.highlight: Surely, you must feel the same way.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方とて判っている筈
findings.governingReading: 貴方とて判っている筈 says he should understand the evident reason she is about to explain.
findings.explanation: Knowing why she is insecure becomes feeling the same negative judgment.

findings.highlight: You waste time on trivial matters.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の行動は無駄が多い
findings.governingReading: 貴方の行動は無駄が多い criticizes inefficiency before the overdue morning greeting.
findings.explanation: His actions containing much wasted motion becomes spending time on trivial matters.
